page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family, provisioned on KVM virtualization. The server is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 60.0 GB of system memory, yielding 7.5 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Hardware acceleration is provided by 2 NVIDIA P100 GPUs delivering a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM.

Local data handling is supported by an integrated 944 GB SSD volume. Network connectivity operates at a 5 Gbps baseline throughput. Public IPv4 routing requires user allocation, as zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned with the instance by default.

This hardware allocation targets workloads that require dedicated GPU execution combined with moderate core counts and dense system memory. The combination of dual NVIDIA P100 processors and 944 GB local SSD space fits parallel computing tasks, machine learning model training, offline batch inference, and scientific simulations requiring fast local scratch storage.
